photo.alt: Colourful Dutch colonial buildings along a harbour quay

facts: About 137,000 people (2011), around 90% of Curaçao's population
Sint Anna Bay splits the centre into Punda and Otrobanda
worth_knowing: Punda was established in 1634 when the Dutch West India Company captured the island from Spain, and Otrobanda followed in 1707. The city centre is a UNESCO World Heritage Site.
